long_biography.plain_text:
Şengün represents the fifth generation of a Bosphorus boatbuilding family. His great-great-grandfather Hüseyin began with a small boathouse, and successive generations kept the craft within the family. Bilgin Şengün later formalised the yard; İsmail, his son, became an owner and chief executive as the business shifted from smaller wooden and composite boats toward internationally marketed custom vessels.

At Bilgin, Şengün has overseen larger steel-and-aluminium projects, expanded vertically integrated facilities across Istanbul, Yalova and Antalya, and worked with specialist naval architects and interior studios. The 80-metre Tatiana programme marked a step change in scale, while newer series extended the yard's production range. He continues to lead a family enterprise that combines generational craftsmanship with modern engineering, outfitting, refit and after-sales capabilities.
